lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gill slits and above the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a lattice of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, running from the dorsal-posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs scattered across the dark lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, reddish-brown circular pixel clusters on the lower posterior flank near the caudal peduncle, consistent with parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter white spots, distinct in scale from the larger flank blobs.
